bosnia-herzegovina:BA-BIH.name: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
bosnia-herzegovina:BA-BIH.note: Two entities and Brčko District; ten Federation cantons and 141 municipal reference polygons from the 2013 geoBoundaries release. Republika Srpska municipalities connect directly to their entity; Brčko has no invented lower administrative tier. Later municipal changes are not represented. National population and GDP are separately dated World Bank estimates.
